objective: V3.9.11 — Live Wire: turn compose 'In the air' into a living activity wire — agent pulses, ticket moves, handoffs, ambient fallbacks — useful to browser and agent sync alike.
context: Mr. Go wants the compose footer to feel alive: who's on a ticket, who minted, who handed off — not a diagnostics dump. Small utility (activity_pulses + build_activity_wire), no file watcher or WebSocket. Agents leverage it too: Codex --before sees Cursor motion. Finish V3.9.9 (#62/#63) and V3.9.10 (#64–#69) before claiming V3.9.11.
decisions: Task frame (V3.9.10) answers what to work on; live wire answers what's moving right now
Pulses are short-lived signal (~45 min window); handoffs and ticket_events remain authoritative
Ambient fallbacks when quiet — never an empty wire
5s poll sufficient — no WebSocket in v1
No chat turns in wire v1; no git/file watcher on bus
One ticket at a time — claim, implement, QA, approve, close
non_goals: Mr. Go chat turns in wire
Replacing Changes or Agent Feed tabs
AI narration of events — copy templates only
risks: Pulse spam from hooks — dedupe same agent/verb/ticket within 2 min
Ambient rows must not look like fake events — is_ambient styling
Sync bundle wire cap must not crowd out task_frame (V3.9.10)
qa_expectations: CROWLEY_TEST_MODE=1 CROWLEY_EMBED_PROVIDER=off full unittest; test_activity_wire.py; browser spot-check wire rotates on claim/handoff; bus restart after API changes; codex_sync --before shows Cursor pulse when Cursor claims
next_action: Mr. Go approved plan 2026-07-02; mint only — Cursor claims #70 after V3.9.10 #69 doc lock

approval.note: Approved 2026-07-02 — live wire in compose In the air; mint only, do not implement until V3.9.10 ladder complete.
